findings.title: Ensure generated default rule IDs do not collide with imported IDs
findings.suggested_fix: Generate collision-free IDs for appended defaults (or normalize all restored rule IDs) while preserving every imported rule.
findings.why_it_matters: An accepted valid imported plan becomes invalid solely through restoration and cannot calculate or save.
evidence: validateInput permits any unique nonempty rule ID independently of kind; defaultRules assigns id=kind; restore fills missing kinds without checking IDs.

Import a schemaVersion 1 plan whose only rule is {id:"tail",kind:"sum",enabled:true,mode:"include",values:[10]}; import validation accepts it. Click 使用方案, then 开始缩水. Restoration appends the default tail rule with the same ID, so validateInput throws 规则标识必须唯一且非空. Saving also fails, and patching either duplicate ID changes both rules.
